Beatles, The - Rock Band.name: The Beatles: Rock Band
Beatles, The - Rock Band.summary:
The Beatles: Rock Band is a 2009 music video game. It is the third major console release in the Rock Band music video game series, in which players can simulate the playing of rock music by using controllers shaped like musical instruments. The Beatles: Rock Band is the first band-centric game in the series, and it is centered on the popular English rock group the Beatles.
The game features virtual portrayals of the four band members performing the songs throughout the band's history, including depictions of some of their famous live performances, as well as a number of "dreamscape" sequences for songs from the Abbey Road Studios recording sessions during the group's studio years.

Idolm@ster, The - Gravure for You! Vol..name: The Idolmaster: Gravure for You! - Vol. 1
Idolm@ster, The - Gravure for You! Vol..summary: The Idolmaster: Gravure For You! is a sub-series of games in the The Idolmaster series of games. In the games, the player can take pictures of idols wearing different outfits while posed. The original release of the game totaled 9 individual volumes released in bundles with episodes of The Idolmaster anime, containing the idols from 765 Production and guest idols from 876 Production. Another set of nine volumes in currently being released for characters from the Cinderella Girls anime.

Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2014.name: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2014
Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2014.summary: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2014 is a baseball game that allows players to compete in Japan's professional baseball league, with licensed team and player names.

Star Ocean - The Last Hope International.summary: A sci‑fi action RPG mixing real‑time combat with party-driven exploration and character progression.
